bvgrupa.subject: Free 2-week AI dispatch pilot for BV Grupa
bvgrupa.body:
Hello BV Grupa team,

I came across BV Grupa while looking at freight companies in Riga. You focus on fTL/LTL road freight with a customs warehouse in Riga, and that is exactly the kind of daily dispatching FleetMind is built for.

FleetMind is a team of AI agents that plans routes, reassigns jobs when traffic, weather or a breakdown hits, keeps drivers within EU hours and tracks fuel cost and CO2. I'd like to offer you a free 2-week pilot on your own routes, with no commitment.

You can try the live demo here: https://agnaykrishna.github.io/fleetmind/?ref=bvgrupa

Best regards,
Agnay Krishna Biju
bagnaykrishna@gmail.com

Not interested? Just reply "no thanks" and I won't contact you again.
